0.original: The Archive insists you affix the soul shard to your person.

48.original: The Archive tells me that crystal is filled with knowledge of ancient combat techniques. Might come in handy on yer excursions.

49.original: I'm still surveyin' these fortifications an' checkin' the wilds for potential dangers. Nobody's leavin' until I'm finished, ye hear?

50.original: Considering the fact you were summoned to the isle especially, I wouldn't be surprised if the soul shard yields its secrets to you. I suggest you try interacting with it.

51.original: You are currently a Phantom Freelancer. Select your chosen phantom job from the window to proceed with the expedition.

52.original: Excellent, it would seem you've managed to interface with the soul shard. There is one caveat: I believe it will only work within the confines of the island's ward. Nonetheless, as you accumulate more knowledge, you'll soon be able to draw on more potent techniques.

53.original: What's more, I don't think that's the only soul shard on the island. I'm positive you'll acquire others on your travels.

54.original: The more you possess, the greater the array of ancient techniques you will have at your fingertips.

55.original: Well, I shan't keep you from your excursions any longer, though you'd better speak to that imposing lass over there before you depart.

56.original: Ofangeim's been inspectin' the structural integrity of these fortifications. Hopefully, she hasn't found anythin' untoward, or we'll be stuck shorin' up these defenses for a spell...

57.original: There's precious little else I can tell you about the soul shards. I suggest you go and speak with Ofangeim.

58.original: I reckon ye'd better try tinkerin' with that there crystal before ye leave.

59.original: These walls have seen better days, but they're solid enough. As long as we secure the entrances, the camp'll be safe while yer out roamin' the isle.

60.original: Roamin's all well and good, but we'll need a firm plan of action if we're to make any headway.

61.original: Before ye leave, let's consider our approach.
